description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for high-throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing of microbial communities from coastal sediment samples, capturing location, timing, environmental conditions, and sequencing context.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sediment sample record.

project_id.descr: Identifier linking the sample to a broader project or study, if applicable.

site_name.descr: Name of the coastal sampling location or site.

location_description.descr: Free-text description of the sampling location, shoreline context, or nearby landmark.

coordinate_precision_m.descr: Estimated coordinate precision in meters for the recorded geographic coordinates.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

administrative_region.descr: State, province, or other administrative region of the sampling site.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

season.descr: Season during which the sample was collected; use a controlled term such as spring, summer, autumn/fall, or winter.

sampling_time_local.descr: Local time of sample collection, if recorded, preferably in 24-hour format (HH:MM).

habitat_type.descr: General habitat classification, e.g. coastal sediment, intertidal sediment, subtidal sediment, estuarine sediment.

tidal_zone.descr: Tidal setting of the sample location, e.g. intertidal, supratidal, subtidal, or not_applicable.

sediment_depth_cm.descr: Depth below the sediment surface from which the sample was collected, in centimeters (cm).

water_depth_m.descr: Overlying water depth at the sampling location, in meters (m), if applicable.

temperature_c.descr: Environmental temperature at the time of sampling, in degrees Celsius (°C).

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity at the sampling location, in practical salinity units (PSU) or equivalent.

pH.descr: Measured pH of the sediment porewater or overlying water, depending on the recorded measurement context.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration, in milligrams per liter (mg/L), if measured.

redox_potential_mv.descr: Redox potential (Eh) of sediment or porewater, in millivolts (mV), if measured.

grain_size_class.descr: Predominant sediment grain size category, e.g. clay, silt, sand, mixed, if assessed.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Organic matter content of the sediment, expressed as percent (%) if measured.

moisture_content_percent.descr: Sediment moisture content, expressed as percent (%) if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_g.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in sediment, in micrograms per gram (µg/g), if measured.

sampling_device.descr: Device or method used to collect the sediment sample, e.g. corer, grab sampler, spatula.

sampling_protocol.descr: Brief free-text description of the collection protocol, including any relevant handling steps.

sediment_storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the sediment sample was stored prior to DNA extraction, in degrees Celsius (°C).

storage_duration_hours.descr: Time between collection and DNA extraction or freezing, in hours.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Name or description of the DNA extraction protocol or kit used.

16s_target_region.descr: 16S rRNA gene variable region targeted for amplification, e.g. V3-V4, V4, V4-V5.

forward_primer_sequence.descr: Forward primer sequence used for 16S amplification, reported as nucleotide sequence.

reverse_primer_sequence.descr: Reverse primer sequence used for 16S amplification, reported as nucleotide sequence.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, e.g. Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, Ion Torrent.

library_preparation_method.descr: Brief description of library preparation workflow, including amplification and indexing strategy.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or batch associated with this sample.

read_length_bp.descr: Length of sequencing reads generated, in base pairs (bp).

replicate_type.descr: Replicate category for the sample, e.g. biological, technical, field_blank, extraction_blank, PCR_blank.

replicate_number.descr: Replicate number within the replicate category, if applicable.

operator_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person or laboratory responsible for sample processing, if recorded.

qa_qc_passed.descr: Indicates whether the sample passed basic quality-control criteria for downstream analysis.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the sample, measurements, or unusual conditions.
